resources.string: Allow access to find your scooter and receive ride data.
Find and connect to your scooter and Bluetooth LED lights.
Required by the Bluetooth scanner. Select precise location and allow access while using the app.
Location is also used to show your position and routes on the map. You can hide the map from the main menu.
Android will ask for permission next. Background location access is not requested here.
Android no longer shows one of the permission requests. Open Permissions in the app settings, allow access, then return here.
